items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Reminds me of a story that this Prince Robinson, maybe you've heard of him. He worked for a band called the Cotton pickers.

ctx.x: We'd get these little tape things together so we wanted to tape our tunes naturally. What the hell, I mean, that's the purpose. So I'd sing some Louis Armstrong (?) and said, That's the way to do it. We didn't tape one record of ours. Reminds me of a story that this Prince Robinson, maybe you've heard of him. He worked for a band called the Cotton pickers.
